t: Requirements Traceability Mapper - public implementations survey
title: Requirements Traceability Mapper - public implementations survey
definition: Links requirements to design, implementation, and tests.
description:
Requirements Traceability Mapper is one of the fundamental capabilities an AI needs to build things on demand: Links requirements to design, implementation, and tests. In the real world this capability is delivered by a rich ecosystem of tools, libraries and platforms. This database is the public edition - a fact-checked survey of the real implementations, the real techniques they share, the standards they follow, and laddered drills that teach the capability hands-on.

No single tool owns Requirements Traceability Mapper. Competing implementations emphasize different trade-offs: speed against flexibility, simplicity against power, integration against independence. The implementation spotlights in this database document the notable real ones - what each does, where it excels, and how it serves Requirements Traceability Mapper. Together they map the territory as it actually exists.

Every record carries a runnable demonstration program, because tools are understood by use. Run the demos with node, compare the implementations, practice the drills, and the Requirements Traceability Mapper capability becomes something you can reach for - with full knowledge of which real tool fits which job.

description:
review checklist is the Requirements Traceability Mapper discipline: Links requirements to design, implementation, and tests. It turns Requirements Traceability Mapper from an event into a repeatable capability.

In practice this means: keep a failure log: what broke, why, and what now prevents it; review the result with fresh eyes before calling it done; declare inputs, expected outputs, and acceptance checks before starting Teams that follow the discipline get predictable builds; teams that skip it get interesting stories. The Signature line prefers predictable builds, and this record's demo makes the discipline concrete and runnable.

t: Foundation drill - name the inputs, outputs, and contracts of Requirements Trac
title: Foundation drill - name the inputs, outputs, and contracts of Requirements Trac
definition: Ladder drill (foundation): name the inputs, outputs, and contracts of Requirements Traceability Mapper from a one-paragraph brief.
description:
Drill (FOUNDATION): name the inputs, outputs, and contracts of Requirements Traceability Mapper from a one-paragraph brief

Read the brief twice. List every input the Requirements Traceability Mapper needs, every output it must produce, and one contract each input-output pair must satisfy. Work it by hand first, then run the demo program and compare its trace against your own reasoning. When they agree, the concept is yours.

Success criterion: you can list them from memory without looking at the brief
